- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.

{"body_md": "## Problem

Payment batch reconciliation breaks down when supplier ledgers and invoices are missing or inaccessible in the system. Separately, uploaded claims documents fail to auto-assign to the correct supplier tasks, disrupting the surrounding workflow. Both behaviours surface through support contacts rather than as tracked defects.

## Who is affected

- 3 accounts have raised this, across 3 mentions, all arriving through the 1 support route [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd] [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5] [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- The affected accounts represent 2770000.0 GBP in ARR: Cindermill Trade Cover at 210000.0 GBP, Wexmoor Motor at 1950000.0 GBP, and Brackwater Homecover at 610000.0 GBP [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd] [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5] [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- Wexmoor Motor is the largest exposure by ARR and reports the reconciliation problem on the documents side [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].
- Brackwater Homecover reports a different failure mode, in auto-assignment rather than reconciliation [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- Cindermill Trade Cover is the only account framing the issue around the supplier ledger specifically [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd].

## Evidence

- Cindermill Trade Cover, on 2026-09-09: the user was trying to work out why the latest payment batch had not reflected in their supplier ledger [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd].
- Wexmoor Motor, on 2026-10-30: the user was trying to reconcile the latest payment batch with suppliers' invoices but could not locate the matching documents in the system [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].
- Brackwater Homecover, on 2026-09-10: the user was trying to work out why the latest batch of claims documents had not auto-assigned to the right supplier tasks [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- All 3 mentions came in via support, and no insight in this set suggests the problem is absent or already resolved for any of these accounts [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd] [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5] [i:f65321d912d263c2].

## Why now

- No renewals fall within the next 90 days: renewals_90d_n is 0, with the nearest renewal at Cindermill Trade Cover on 2027-04-03, followed by Wexmoor Motor on 2027-06-30 and Brackwater Homecover on 2027-10-10 [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd] [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5] [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- The Wexmoor Motor mention is dated 2026-10-30, after the 2026-10-01 as-of date of this fact sheet, so the issue is still live [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].
- The two reconciliation-related accounts together represent a substantial share of the 2770000.0 GBP total ARR in scope [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd] [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].", "citations": ["550f2b6c46f2b3dd", "d93acbbda99a4ae5", "f65321d912d263c2"]}
